events.name: Boston Red Sox at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Charles McAdoo homered and Jameson Taillon pitched four scoreless innings before leaving with an injury as the Toronto Blue Jays beat Boston 2-1 on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Charles McAdoo homers and Blue Jays win 2-1 to hand the Red Sox their 3rd straight loss

events.name: New York Mets at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Brett Baty hit the first grand slam of his career and the New York Mets held off the Atlanta Braves 8-5 on Monday night for their sixth win in seven games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brett Baty hits his first career grand slam to spark the Mets’ 8-5 win over the Braves

headlines.description: — Austin Martin had four hits including a home run, Josh Bell also homered and the Minnesota Twins beat the Baltimore Orioles 9-5 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Martin goes 4 for 5, including a home run in the Twins' 9-5 win over the Orioles

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Edmundo Sosa drove in three runs and Kyle Schwarber reached base four times as the Philadelphia Phillies beat the St. Louis Cardinals 6-5 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schwarber, Sosa and Painter power the Phillies to a 6-5 win over the Cardinals

events.name: Texas Rangers at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Brandon Nimmo singled home the go-ahead run in the 10th inning and the Texas Rangers beat the Los Angeles Angels 4-1 on Monday night to snap a five-game road losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brandon Nimmo's single in 10th inning helps Rangers beat Angels 4-1 to snap 5-game road skid

headlines.description: — Nolan Areando hit a grand slam in the first inning against his former team, Michael Soroka had a successful return on the mound and the Arizona Diamondbacks jumped out to a big early lead for a 9-0 win over the Colorado Rockies on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nolan Arenado hits 8th career grand slam, D-backs cruise in a 9-0 win over the Rockies

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Jackson Merrill hit a two-run homer to center field in the seventh inning and Mason Miller earned his NL-leading 30th save to give the San Diego Padres a 3-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Merrill's 2-run homer and Miller's 30th save lead the Padres to a 3-2 win over the Brewers

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Junior Caminero hit a three-run homer in an eight-run eighth inning as the Tampa Bay Rays rallied for a 10-6 victory over the Athletics on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Caminero hits a three-run homer as Rays rally with an eight-run eighth and beat the Athletics 10-6

events.name: Houston Astros at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Jeremy Pe a hit a go-ahead single with none out in the 10th, Isaac Paredes added a two-run double one out later and the Houston Astros rallied for a 6-3 victory over the San Francisco Giants on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jeremy Pe a hits go-ahead single, Isaac Paredes 2-run double in 10th as Astros rally past Giants 6-3

events.name: Kansas City Royals at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Tarik Skubal yielded three runs over five innings in his home debut for the Dodgers, and Shohei Ohtani scored the go-ahead run in the seventh while Los Angeles rallied for only its second victory in 10 games, 6-5 over the Kansas City Royals on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Ohtani scores go-ahead run in 7th, Dodgers rally to beat Royals 6-5 in Tarik Skubal's home debut
